name: multiball_drain_transfer
description: Slot 0 below the drain line, slot 1 alone in play: EP2 drain (cs:0A63..0AA3) moves slot 1 into slot 0 (active, x, y, vx, vy; not the accumulators or layer) and clears slot 1, so the trace of slot 0 continues with slot 1's ball from frame 0 and no serve happens.
